performance_tasks.brief: Section B-style story, 600–900 words, which must begin with an original sentence given in the prompt, creating a sense of suspense; model answer and guidance against the 25-mark table
Section B-style story, 600–900 words, with the title of an original prompt, creating a sense of loss and recovery; model answer and guidance against the 25-mark table
Section B-style description, 600–900 words, of a crowded place in the moments before an event begins, creating a sense of anticipation; model answer and guidance against the 25-mark table
Section B-style description, 600–900 words, of a landscape as the weather changes, creating a sense of calm turning to threat; model answer and guidance against the 25-mark table

ao_mix_note: Marks-equivalent counts the performance tasks at the AO split of the level table each models. Flashcards model no paper item and carry no tariff, so they count nothing here; they carry their objective’s AOs.
